summary: [standards] l1_cases() plants three validator conditions (refused, declared-code, field-is-an-argument). Scenario 14 and brief F3/F6 name a fake that answers a precondition code without setup / reads its state first; no case plants it, and nothing can: the judge (l1.rs l1_validators) cannot tell a precondition code from any code other than the validator's, so that variant is the declared-code condition. Verified by a wrapper over the fake that answers another code when state.txt is absent: only L1.validators fails. 'Nothing was written' is owned by L0.refusal-effects (it measures every exit-2 call, validators' included), so it has no L1.validators case; say so in the test or scenario. Blast radius: none beyond naming.
